# pickers API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

SharePoint metadata and principal discovery, scoped references and explicit selection.

## ContentTypePicker

Select read-only SharePoint content type references from a collection root or one list.
Requires an SPFx toolkit provider with SPHttpClient. Site scope (default) resolves the owning
collection root even for a subweb URL; list scope preserves the owning web and exact list copy ID.
Defaults to Dropdown (historical combobox presentation), single selection and includeHidden=true. Opening retrieves every REST
page, sorts by Name then ID, and caches the complete catalog. Typed search matches name prefixes
locally and case-insensitively; no personal history or initial 30-item cap applies.
Inherits PickerProps model seeds, reactive availableOptions, array selection events, errors,
accessibility and fixed presentation slots. ReadOnly/Sealed do not remove choices. Invalid
IDs/configuration throw synchronously; request failures use the inherited onError contract.

### Imports

```ts
import { ContentTypePicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { ContentTypePicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { ContentTypePicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pickers';
```

### Use when

- A user must select content types from a site collection, web or list catalog.

### Avoid when

- Use FieldPicker for column definitions within a list.

### Examples

#### Current collection catalog

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { ContentTypePicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<ContentTypePicker label="Site content type" webUrl="https://tenant.sharepoint.com/sites/hr/sub" />
```

#### List catalog

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { ContentTypePicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<ContentTypePicker label="List content type" scope="list" list="Documents" contentTypeId="0x0101" includeDescendants multiselect />
```

### Signatures

```ts
(props: ContentTypePickerProps): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
```

#### Parameters

- `props`: Catalog scope/list selector, optional group/ID/hidden filters, selection models and native presentation.

#### Returns

A Fluent Field with Dropdown or TagPicker. Single and multiple selections both use scoped reference arrays.

## FieldPicker

Search list fields or site columns beneath an SPFx provider, with icons based on verified field types.
Defaults: Dropdown (historical combobox presentation), multiple selection, hidden/read-only included, Title ascending.
Opening the menu loads all matching fields, following native paging. Typed search filters the complete memory-cached catalog locally, case-insensitively; no initial display limit.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import { FieldPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { FieldPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { FieldPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pickers';
```

### Use when (2)

- A user must select fields from a specified SharePoint list.

### Avoid when (2)

- Use ContentTypePicker when the configuration requires content-type identities.

### Examples (2)

```tsx

import { FieldPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<FieldPicker label="Campi" list="Projects" includeReadOnly={false} />
```


A native Fluent Field and picker; blank clearing emits an empty array.

## ListItemPicker

Search actual list items/files/folders beneath an SPFx provider, beyond consumer-provided menu candidates.
Defaults: TagPicker, multiple selection, Id key, startsWith search, folders excluded.
Text/calculated/nontext fields use the appropriate REST/CAML projection with bounded paging.

### Imports (3)

```ts
import { ListItemPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { ListItemPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { ListItemPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pickers';
```

### Use when (3)

- A user must select serializable list-item or file/folder references from one configured list.

### Avoid when (3)

- Use FileFolderPicker for hosted file browsing across supported storage sources.

### Examples (3)

```tsx

import { ListItemPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<ListItemPicker label="Documenti" list="Documents" textField="FileLeafRef" presentation="tagPicker" />
```

## ListPicker

Search SharePoint lists through the nearest SPFx provider; consumer candidates are independent of selection.
Defaults: Dropdown (historical combobox presentation), single selection, includeHidden=true, Title ascending, search from two characters.
Opening the menu loads up to 30 available options (initialCatalogLimit: integer 1–200). Typed search is case insensitive and independent of this catalog.

### Imports (4)

```ts
import { ListPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { ListPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { ListPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pickers';
```

### Use when (4)

- A user must select lists from a known or current SharePoint web.

### Avoid when (4)

- Use SitePicker first when the source web itself must be selected.

### Examples (4)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { ListPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<ListPicker label="Lista" baseTemplate={[100,101]} onOptionSelect={(_,data) => console.log(data.selectedValues)} />
```

### Signatures (4)

```ts
(props: ListPickerProps): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
```

#### Parameters (4)

- `props`: Query source, scoped models, selection and Fluent presentation options.

#### Returns (4)

Accessible Fluent Field and picker. No persistence or provisioning.

## ContentTypePickerValue

Serializable content type reference. The hierarchical SharePoint ID is not a GUID.
Site values identify the verified collection root; list values retain the owning web and list copy ID.
JSON contains only this reference and the optional inherited display snapshot, never group/flags.

### Imports (5)

```ts
import type { ContentTypePickerValue } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { ContentTypePickerValue } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { ContentTypePickerValue } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pickers';
import type { ContentTypePickerValue } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/property-pane/pickers';
```

### Examples (5)

#### Site content type identity

```ts
import { ContentTypePickerValue } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const site: ContentTypePickerValue = {kind:'contentType',scope:'site',webUrl:'https://tenant.sharepoint.com/sites/hr',contentTypeId:'0x0101'};
```

#### List content type identity

```ts
import { ContentTypePickerValue } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const list: ContentTypePickerValue = {kind:'contentType',scope:'list',webUrl:'https://tenant.sharepoint.com/sites/hr/sub',listId:'11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111',contentTypeId:'0x0101'};
```

### Type

```ts
type ContentTypePickerValue = PickerValueLabel & {
  /**
   * Required content type domain discriminator.
   */
  readonly kind: 'contentType';
  /**
   * Required hierarchical ID: System root 0x or 0x followed by nonzero hex bytes or 00 plus 32 hex GUID digits; comparison ignores case.
   */
  readonly contentTypeId: string;
} & ({
  /**
   * Collection catalog scope; never inferred from listId.
   */
  readonly scope: 'site';
  /**
   * Required verified absolute collection root web URL.
   */
  readonly webUrl: string;
  /**
   * Forbidden for site content types.
   * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
   */
  readonly listId?: never;
} | {
  /**
   * List catalog scope; preserves the list copy rather than its site ancestor.
   */
  readonly scope: 'list';
  /**
   * Required absolute URL of the web owning the list.
   */
  readonly webUrl: string;
  /**
   * Required GUID identifying the owning list.
   */
  readonly listId: string;
})
```

## ContentTypePickerProps

Read-only collection or list content type picker. Requires an SPFx toolkit provider with SPHttpClient.
Inherits PickerProps selection arrays, model seeds, independent consumer candidates, callbacks,
accessibility and slots. Defaults to single Dropdown (historical combobox presentation), complete Name/ID ascending catalog, local
case-insensitive name-prefix search, and includeHidden=true. No personal/recent source is added.
webUrl inherits the provider web; site scope resolves its collection root even from a subweb.
List strings are exact titles; use the existing typed selector for IDs/paths/URLs.

```ts
import type { ContentTypePickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/property-pane/pickers';
```


### Type (19)

```ts
type ContentTypePickerProps = PickerProps<ContentTypePickerOption> & WebPickerSource & {
  /**
   * Optional exact group match, case insensitive. When omitted, accepts all groups.
   */
  readonly group?: string;
  /**
   * Include hidden types. when omitted, defaults to true; readOnly/sealed do not affect eligibility.
   * @defaultValue true
   */
  readonly includeHidden?: boolean;
  /**
   * Optional valid hierarchical ID filter; exact match unless includeDescendants=true.
   * When omitted, no hierarchical content-type ID restriction is applied.
   */
  readonly contentTypeId?: string;
  /**
   * Include the filtered ID and all hierarchical descendants. when omitted, defaults to false; true requires contentTypeId.
   * @defaultValue false
   */
  readonly includeDescendants?: boolean;
} & ({
  /**
   * Catalog scope; when omitted, selects the owning site collection root.
   */
  readonly scope?: 'site';
  /**
   * Forbidden for collection scope.
   * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
   */
  readonly list?: never;
} | {
  /**
   * Required list scope discriminator when a list is supplied.
   */
  readonly scope: 'list';
  /**
   * Required exact existing toolkit list selector in its owning web.
   */
  readonly list: string | SPFxPnPListSelector;
})
```

## PickerProps

Native Fluent Field label/hint/validation slots keep their peer contracts.
Rendering requires a nonblank plain string label or explicit `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby`;
JSX and object labels require explicit ARIA naming even when they display text.
The renderer throws TypeError when neither naming input is supplied.
Single Dropdown offers native clearable selection through the validated clear event; multiple Dropdown deselects options and TagPicker dismisses tags. No default separate bulk-clear button is rendered.

### Imports (38)

```ts
import type { PickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { PickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { PickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pickers';
import type { PickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/property-pane/pickers';
```

### Examples (38)

#### Typed configuration

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { PickerProps, SitePickerOption } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const props: PickerProps<SitePickerOption> = { label: 'Site', presentation: 'combobox', availableOptions: [] };
```

#### Accessible JSX label

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SitePicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<SitePicker label={<span>Site</span>} aria-label="Site" />
```

## PickerProps.validateSelection

Validates resolved models before an action commits, according to validationTrigger.
Undefined/empty string accepts; a nonempty message blocks the action without changing selection
or calling onOptionSelect. Promises are awaited. Throws/rejections report through onError
and the failure UI without committing. When omitted, adds no custom validation.
External validationMessage overrides only the displayed message, not this acceptance decision.

## PrincipalInitialSuggestions

Principal pre-search policy. Consumer candidates precede the independent current user,
then “Persone suggerite” and “I tuoi gruppi”. Later sections may be truncated by the shared limit.
Current user is filtered/deduplicated like other sources; it does not displace consumer candidates.
No ensureUser call runs for suggestions. No selection history or automatic persistence exists.

## PrincipalPickerInitialPrincipal

Initial references are consumed once; subsequent controlled updates use selectedOptions/initialOptions.
displayOnly preserves the old PnP title-only scenario as an unresolved key, not a verified identity.

## PrincipalPickerProps

Unified user/group selection with common Fluent presentation, search and Property Pane lifecycle.
All principal suggestions use Persona; selected tags use name plus user avatar/group icon.
principalTypes changes affect suggestions without silently dropping incompatible existing selections.
Empty principalTypes disables suggestions. userIdentity applies only to users, never groups.
Graph/SharePoint permissions and available identities govern actual resolution; a matching SPFx provider is required.

### Imports (44)

```ts
import type { PrincipalPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { PrincipalPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { PrincipalPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pickers';
import type { PrincipalPickerProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/property-pane/pickers';
```

### Examples (46)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { PrincipalPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<PrincipalPicker label="Principals" principalTypes={['user', 'microsoft365Group']} presentation="tagPicker" multiselect
  userIdentity={{ mode: 'both', webUrl: 'https://tenant.sharepoint.com/sites/projects', ensureUser: true }} />
```

## UserIdentityResolution

Required user identities; existing IDs are retained, never filtered from results by this mode.
Omitting userIdentity selects available mode. Entra resolution is read-only Graph work.
SharePoint resolution without ensureUser reads only an existing registration; missing registration is an error.
ensureUser defaults to false, may register users, and runs only on confirmation/explicit resolution.
Destination defaults to PrincipalPickerProps.webUrl, then the provider's current web.
A requested identity failure prevents confirmation of a new selection. Preserve existing controlled keys.
Changing this configuration does not silently provision users or delete selections; resolve on an explicit action.

```ts
type UserIdentityResolution = | {
  /**
   * Required user identity mode. Available retains returned IDs; entra requires a verified directory ID; sharePoint and both require a target collection registration.
   */
  readonly mode: 'available' | 'entra' }
  | {
      /**
       * Required user identity mode. Available retains returned IDs; entra requires a verified directory ID; sharePoint and both require a target collection registration.
       */
  readonly mode: 'sharePoint' | 'both';
      /**
       * SharePoint identity-resolution destination. When omitted, uses PrincipalPickerProps.webUrl, then the provider current web.
       */
  readonly webUrl?: string;
      /**
       * Allows registering a missing SharePoint user only during explicit selection or ID resolution. when omitted, defaults to false; never runs during search, hydration or configuration changes.
       */
  readonly ensureUser?: boolean;
    }
```

## UserPrincipal

Directory/SharePoint user snapshot; optional IDs allow unresolved initial/controlled values.
sharePointId is scoped to the collection containing sharePointWebUrl; Entra ID is scoped to entraTenantId.
Confirmed new selections satisfy the configured userIdentity requirements.

## PickersStrings

## PickersStringsOverride

Optional instance dictionary, merged by known group and leaf. Undefined retains native defaults;
empty strings remain explicit overrides. Direct control labels/content/Field messages take precedence.
Changes update subsequent rendering and actions without resetting selection or changing hosted UI culture.


```ts
};
```

## PrincipalPicker

Unified user/SharePoint/Entra group picker beneath an SPFx provider.
Defaults: TagPicker, multiple users, available IDs, no personal/current suggestions and no provisioning.
Delegated People.Read/User.Read and directory/membership permissions depend on enabled sources. Graph-dependent operations wait for native client initialization; terminal initialization errors are reported without blocking SharePoint-only operations.

### Imports (57)

```ts
import { PrincipalPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { PrincipalPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { PrincipalPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pickers';
```

### Use when (5)

- A user must select people or configured SharePoint/Entra group categories with verified scoped identities.

### Avoid when (5)

- Use advisory access trims for membership decisions; a picker selection is not an authorization check.

### Examples (59)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { PrincipalPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<PrincipalPicker label="Destinatari" principalTypes={['user','microsoft365Group']} userIdentity={{mode:'both',ensureUser:false}} />
```

### Signatures (16)

```ts
(props: PrincipalPickerProps): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
```

#### Parameters (27)

- `props`: Principal categories/scopes, independent consumer/seed models and explicit ID resolution policy.

#### Returns (23)

A native Fluent picker. ensureUser only runs on accepted user actions or explicit ID resolution.

## SitePicker

Search site collections or hubs with the provider's authenticated clients and memory-only query caching.
Defaults: site collection mode, Dropdown (historical combobox presentation), single selection, Title ascending. Initial menu includes consumer options, current collection and associated hub; includeCurrentSite/includeHubSite both default true.

### Imports (58)

```ts
import { SitePicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { SitePicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { SitePicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pickers';
```

### Use when (6)

- A user must select site collection references, registered hubs or associated sites.

### Avoid when (6)

- Use ListPicker to select a list within a known source web.

### Examples (60)

#### Basic usage

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SitePicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<SitePicker label="Sito" mode="site" includeCurrentSite includeHubSite />
```

#### Compare contextual search and custom feedback

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SitePicker, ListPicker, PrincipalPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
// Render beneath the initialized matching SPFx provider. Search does not grant access.
function SearchFeedbackChoices() {
  return <section>
    <SitePicker label="Site" minimumSearchLength={3} includeCurrentSite includeHubSite />
    <ListPicker label="List" emptyContent="Nessuna lista disponibile per i criteri correnti" />
    <PrincipalPicker label="Principals" loadingContent="Ricerca persone e gruppi…" />
  </section>;
}
```

### Signatures (17)

```ts
(props: SitePickerProps): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
```

#### Parameters (28)

- `props`: Site mode/scope, models, selection and presentation options. KQL is supported only in mode="site".

#### Returns (24)

A native Fluent Field and site picker; changing display props retains its runtime.

### Related types (51)

- React.JSXElementConstructor — external dependency (`node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts`); its upstream contract applies.

- React.ReactElement — external dependency (`node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts`); its upstream contract applies.

- [SitePickerProps](pickers.md#sitepickerprops)

## ViewPicker

Search public/personal SharePoint list views through an SPFx provider.
Defaults: Dropdown (historical combobox presentation), single selection, Title ascending; a list is required.
Opening the menu loads all matching views, following native paging. Typed search filters the complete memory-cached catalog locally, case-insensitively; no initial display limit.

### Imports (59)

```ts
import { ViewPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { ViewPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { ViewPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/pickers';
```

### Use when (7)

- A user must select saved views of a specified SharePoint list.

### Avoid when (7)

- Use ListItemPicker for actual item selection rather than view definitions.

### Examples (61)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { ViewPicker } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<ViewPicker label="Vista" list={{kind:'id',id:'11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111'}} />
```

### Signatures (18)

```ts
(props: ViewPickerProps): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
```

#### Parameters (29)

- `props`: Exact toolkit list selector, filters, reference models and presentation.

#### Returns (25)

A native Fluent Field and view picker; selection values always remain scoped arrays.

### Related types (52)

- React.JSXElementConstructor — external dependency (`node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts`); its upstream contract applies.

- React.ReactElement — external dependency (`node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts`); its upstream contract applies.

- [ViewPickerProps](pickers.md#viewpickerprops)
